chunks: Water and its heaviness were mentioned in the presence of al-Sadiq عليه السلام on the road to Mecca.
He said: "Water is not heavy unless the camel is carrying only water and there is nothing upon it other than water."

key_terms.الْجَمَلُ: the camel used as the load-bearing animal
key_terms.الْمَاءُ: water being discussed as transported provision
key_terms.طَرِيقِ: the route or road of travel
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the destination of pilgrimage travel
key_terms.يَنْفَرِدَ: to be alone or exclusive in being carried

ai.seo_question: When is carrying water considered a heavy load on the road to Mecca according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام addresses a practical ruling related to carrying water during travel to Mecca. It indicates that water is not considered burdensome in transport unless the camel is exclusively laden with water and carries nothing else.
